items.name: Model Development Lifecycle
items.description: Problem definition, data prep, modeling, validation, deployment, monitoring documented
fragments: Problem definition, data prep, modeling, validation, deployment, monitoring documented

items.name: Model Monitoring
items.description: Drift detection; performance metrics tracked; retraining triggers defined

items.name: Model Validation
items.description: Holdout validation; bias testing; explainability requirements; model risk review

items.name: Dashboard Standards
items.description: Consistent design language; mobile-friendly; performance <5 sec load; drill-down capability

items.name: Report Development Standards
items.description: Requirements documented; data validation; UAT sign-off; refresh schedule defined

items.name: Self-Service Guidelines
items.description: Certified datasets for self-service; training required; governed data sources only

items.name: Data Catalog Standards
items.description: All datasets registered; business glossary terms linked; lineage captured; searchable

items.name: Metadata Standards
items.description: Technical and business metadata required; ownership, classification, refresh frequency documented

items.name: Data Lake Standards
items.description: Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold); partitioning strategy; file formats (Parquet/Delta)

items.name: ETL/ELT Standards
items.description: ELT preferred; incremental loads; CDC for real-time; audit columns in all tables

items.name: Pipeline Standards
items.description: Idempotent; schema evolution handled; data contracts enforced; monitoring/alerting

items.name: Data Governance Framework
items.description: Roles, responsibilities, policies documented; Data Council meets monthly; escalation path defined

items.name: Data Ownership
items.description: Every dataset has assigned owner and steward; accountability documented; annual review
fragments: Every dataset has assigned owner and steward

items.name: Data Policies
items.description: Policies for access, retention, quality, privacy; approved by Data Council; communicated org-wide
fragments: Policies for access, retention, quality, privacy

items.name: Master Data Standards
items.description: Golden record rules defined; match/merge logic documented; survivorship rules

items.name: Reference Data Management
items.description: Code tables centrally managed; versioned; change control process; no local overrides

items.name: Data Classification
items.description: All data classified (Public/Internal/Confidential/Restricted); labeling enforced

items.name: Data Retention
items.description: Retention schedules by data type; automated purge where possible; legal hold process

items.name: PII Handling
items.description: PII inventory maintained; encryption/masking applied; access logged; retention enforced

items.name: Data Issue Management
items.description: Issues logged in tracking system; root cause analysis; prevention measures implemented

items.name: Data Quality Rules
items.description: DQ rules defined by data domain; automated profiling; DQ scores published
fragments: DQ rules defined by data domain

items.name: Data Quality SLAs
items.description: Completeness >99%; Accuracy >99%; Timeliness per business SLA; remediation within 24 hours
